# S0003: RIPTIDE

<a id="s0003"></a>

Type: malware  
ATT&CK: [S0003](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0003)  
Platforms: Windows  

[RIPTIDE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0003) is a proxy-aware backdoor used by [APT12](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0005).

- [T1071.001: Web Protocols](/mitre/techniques/T1071-001.md)
- [T1573.001: Symmetric Cryptography](/mitre/techniques/T1573-001.md)
